implementation: Local recording AIR builders defer symbolic constant add, subtract, negate and multiply to a fallible normalization pass using the explicit Folding backend; native builders remain the independent CPU reference
Registry fingerprints and geometry, recursive batch and uni verifier constraints, and merge/finalizer registration templates use the selected symbolic backend

Normalization preserves pinned p3-air simplification order, base-representable extension constant behavior, input Arc sharing, exact constraint order and recomputed degrees without structural interning
Lookup collection and packing preserve pinned p3-lookup bus ordering, columns, greedy degree bounds and saturating count weights using metadata operations
All recorded roots are admitted before folding: at most 131072 nodes and depth 512; shared nodes are revisited at greater depth, degree sums and quotient-degree bit calculations reject overflow

Workers reserve an additional 64 MiB of transient host graph, memo and traversal memory in both Rust and Python resource models; raw AIR evaluation remains restricted to trusted internal types and the bounded service

Registered setup and direct GPU preprocessing reject host reservation shortfalls before PCS/device-session creation; exact-threshold resource tests and native allocation/upload checks enforce ordering

Backend failures propagate without CPU fallback; completed preprocessing observations survive later failure; no borrowed backend or device session enters normalized constraints, immutable programs or worker packets
limitations: Integration proofs are bounded recursive empty proofs at height 2048, not full-size wrapped-wallet, merged, finalized or mixed-transaction root proofs
Root conformance covers all transaction kinds, ordered dense prefixes, padding, context binding, metadata rejection and finalizer derivation; this is not a full transaction-throughput measurement
Compiler and registry symbolic arithmetic use the selected backend; machine/backend.rs and gpu_quotient_prover still call native symbolic builders, so complete GPU proving arithmetic is not claimed
Wallet symbolic constraints, template shapes and periodic-verifier checks do not qualify full wallet/pair programs or proofs; raw recording is not a sandbox for arbitrary remote AIR code
Individual remaining stage observations and strict GPU admission are unfinished
Wallet/batch and C-ABI proving arithmetic, unsupported legacy/profile arithmetic, AMD/Metal qualification, full-size memory, cancellation/retry and sustained pool throughput remain open
